title: AI Agent Oversight Policy
description: All autonomous AI agents operate under human supervision with explicit capability contracts, audit logging, and fail-safe termination procedures.

sections.heading: Capability Contracts
sections.body: Every agent must have a registered capability contract defining scope, permissions, inputs, outputs, and termination conditions.

sections.heading: Audit
sections.body: All agent actions are logged to the institutional audit log with actor, action, resource, timestamp, and detail.
